result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would rewire human empathy—not by adding more of it, but by making it unavoidable. Not the performative kind, but the visceral, gut-level kind that makes you feel another’s pain as your own, their joy as your joy, regardless of distance, difference, or division.  

No more “us vs. them.” Just *us*.  

The rest—peace, justice, care for the planet—would follow.
